description.value: Real Food Café is a weekday lunch spot in downtown Nanaimo built around the philosophy of using only natural, unprocessed ingredients. The kitchen turns out four house-made soups daily alongside fresh sandwiches, salads, and artisan cakes baked in-house. It's a solid midday refueling stop for cyclists seeking a wholesome, made-from-scratch meal.
